exposure: mode of delivery at first childbirth
Mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal, instrumental vaginal, planned cesarean, unplanned cesarean)
Mode of delivery at first childbirth
finding: Women who had unplanned cesarean delivery had the least positive feelings overall about their first childbirth compared to other delivery modes.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by unplanned cesarean were more likely to feel disappointed and like a failure, and less likely to feel proud of themselves compared to women who had spontaneous vaginal delivery.
